page.overview:
Who is Millennium Guardians?

The Millennium Guardians (千年守護兵 Sennen Shugohei) are characters appearing in Yu-Gi-Oh! Reshef of Destruction. They give Millennium Items to the player when defeated in a Duel. They are based on members of Shadi's Tomb Guardian clan from the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga.

The player can Duel ten Millennium Guardians. Five of them guard an individual Millennium Item and are located in different areas. The other five can be Dueled on the Great Wall of China as part of Paradox's puzzle.

The Millennium Necklace Guardian Dueled the player at the Egypt exhibition.
